value.rationale: The unique minimal 4-regular girth-five cage is a distinguished finite substrate for nearest-neighbor exclusion RSA, for which regular-tree asymptotic coverage is only a benchmark, not a finite law. The exact three-valued jamming distribution and nonuniform three-orbit occupation probabilities answer natural finite-volume kinetic questions, and provide checkable benchmarks for finite-girth effects. The inequality of site occupation probabilities despite common degree/girth is a concrete structural feature not determined by elementary graph parameters; no trivial renaming, mean bound or known database tabulation yields the evaluated fractions.
